name: Serena: Dark confessions
source:
Julian and Serena, a happy couple, engaged and soon to be married, ready for a picture-perfect ever after. It was a heartwarming tale of clumsy mistakes flowering into solid romance and the promise of something greater. But promises can be broken, and this one was shattered by Julian, who strayed from his fiancée, and by Nicole, Serena’s best friend, who took her husband to be. And Serena left, and Julian… drifted.

It… wasn’t easy, being the bad guy. Nicole stood by his side, cheerful, vibrating with life and energy as always. He worked in his beloved car workshop, the place where he could feel his skills were worth something. But every day, knowing all that he had, he couldn’t stop thinking about what he no longer did. Self-respect was quite high on that list.

And not knowing what Serena was doing, or with whom? That wasn’t easy. Not even Jade, the girl who should have been his sister-in-law, knew. Julian’s ex was now a mystery, and as much as he missed her sometimes, as much as he wished he could somehow make things better…

But this is all the past, part of a story that’s already been told, that you know. And this game? No, this is the part yet to come. This is the part of the story where lingering embers blaze, where we meet the characters we thought we knew and see new ones step into the limelight. This is where we learn about Serena’s past, the secrets she now guards. This is where Julian chooses. And you with him.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1806120/Serena_Dark_confessions/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
朱利安和瑟琳娜是一对幸福的夫妇，他们订婚了，很快就要结婚了，准备迎接美好的永远。这是一个感人的故事，讲述了笨拙的错误最终变成了坚实的浪漫，并承诺了更伟大的事情。但承诺是可以被打破的，这一承诺被朱利安（朱利安）和妮可（塞雷娜最好的朋友，她的丈夫）打破了，朱利安与他的未婚妻背道而驰。瑟琳娜离开了，朱利安……随波逐流。

这……当坏人并不容易。妮可站在他身边，一如既往地充满活力和活力，心情愉快。他在他心爱的汽车车间工作，在那里他觉得自己的技能是有价值的。但每天，当他知道自己拥有的一切时，他就无法停止思考自己不再做的事情。自尊在这份清单上的排名相当靠前。

不知道瑟琳娜在做什么，或者和谁在一起？这并不容易。就连本应是他嫂子的女孩杰德也不知道。朱利安的前任现在成了一个谜，尽管他有时很想念她，尽管他希望自己能以某种方式让事情变得更好……

但这都是过去的事了，是一个已经被讲述过的故事的一部分，你知道。还有这个游戏？不，这是尚未到来的部分。这是故事的一部分，余烬余烬熊熊燃烧，我们遇到了我们自以为认识的角色，并看到新的角色走进了聚光灯下。在这里，我们了解瑟琳娜的过去，以及她现在守护的秘密。这就是朱利安选择的地方。还有你和他。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1806120/Serena_Dark_confessions/]Steam[/url]]
